responsibility: Implements the function-declaration hierarchy and much of the symbol-side behavior of D functions and special function kinds. It constructs `FuncDeclaration` objects, handles syntax copying, contract-related queries, and common per-function state, and defines the concrete subclasses and behavior for constructors, destructors, static/shared constructors and destructors, invariants, unittests, allocators, and deallocators that semantic analysis later elaborates.
